name: The Pier
description: A long wooden pier slick with fog. Mooring stones run along its edge, and the ferry steps are at the near end.

features.name: Mooring stones
features.description: Eleven stones worn smooth by rope. The third is loose.

features.name: Ferry steps
features.description: Nine wet steps down to the water.

exits.description: the lane up to the market
the cliff road, behind an iron gate
exits.note: Closed "for repairs" by order of the harbor master.
